columns.description: The top of this entity's ownership chain, and the ONLY safe column to group on for a roll-up. Three Chenega operating companies share one ultimate parent; summing on `tribe_id` would report them as three unrelated entities. An entity that is its own top carries its own id here rather than a blank, so a roll-up can group unconditionally.
